en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing a grand, ornate building with a mansard roof and decorative ironwork. The building is labeled 'Kaiserl. Postamt' (Imperial Post Office) and is situated next to a bridge over a small body of water. Trees and other buildings are visible in the background. At the top left, the text 'Borna b. Leipzig' is printed, indicating the location near Leipzig.
